== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Glossary removes the movement exception and broadens the piloting bonus. Both affect the Dark Side Cloud City card. The Light Side and foil retain their own identities outside this comparison.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=81 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 81. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=4 Decipher Errata], PDF page 4. Players Committee, Appendix A, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=119 2023 Advanced Rulebook], PDF page 119.
